name: devbox installer
description: Install Devbox in your CICD workflow

project-path.description: Project path to devbox.json. Default to the root directory of the repository.

enable-cache.description: Caching the entire Nix store in github based on your devbox.json

refresh-cli.description: Specify whether the CLI should be redownloaded

devbox-version.description: Specify devbox CLI version you want to pin to. Default to latest

sha256-checksum.description: Specify an explicit checksum for the devbox binary. For extra security on top of the existing checks in the devbox launch script

disable-nix-access-token.description: Disable configuration of nix access-tokens with the GitHub token used in the workflow
